title: WorldOS UI playtest bug record
description: One bug/UX finding emitted by the AI playtester (issue #324). bugs.ndjson holds one of these objects per line. Records come from the Player persona (source=player), the harness's passive console/network capture (source=auto), or a give_up (source=give_up).

action_seq.description: The palette action sequence number in effect when the bug was recorded.

persona.description: Persona slug for the run, e.g. 'newbie'.

category.description: Kind of finding. 'console'/'network' are auto-captured by the harness; the rest are persona-reported.

severity.description: critical = blocks all play; major = blocks the current task; minor = annoying; trivial = cosmetic.

expected.description: What a real user expected to happen.

screenshot.description: Run-relative path to the evidence screenshot, e.g. 'screenshots/step-012-bug.png'. May be empty.

evidence.description: Structured evidence for auto-captured findings (console_error, pageerror, network_failure, http_status).

tried_alternatives.description: Other things the player tried before reporting.

blocks_progress.description: Whether this stopped the player from continuing.

source.description: Origin of the record: the Player persona, the harness's passive capture, or a give_up.
